summary: Thorough E2E testing of the 4 newly added features on Studio Market 41. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py with 13 tests covering password-reset (generic response, token creation, full reset flow, token reuse rejection, short password, invalid token), vendor-profile auto-save on booking + /auth/me returns saved fields, and reschedule (same-duration OK, wrong-duration 400, unauth 401, cancelled 400, conflict 409). All 13 pass. Prior regression suites remain green (test_backend.py 19/19, test_auth_roles.py 19/19). Frontend: /forgot-password renders + generic success for unknown emails via forgot-sent, /login has user-forgot, /admin/login has admin-forgot; /reset-password mismatched pw rejected, success shows reset-done with both user and admin login links, reused token rejected with red error banner; NavigationHeader on / shows nav-admin-dashboard + nav-admin-logout for admin, nav-my-bookings + nav-logout for user, nav-login when logged out; admin nav-admin-logout works and clears session; Reschedule modal opens from /my-bookings with reschedule-<code>, reschedule-date drives available reschedule-start-<hour> buttons constrained to same duration, reschedule-submit persists new date/hour and total is unchanged; Vendor profile prefill on next booking: all 6 fields (name, business_name, email, phone, description, products) come pre-filled in Step 'Your Details'.

design_issues.screen: Home (/) header for logged-in user/admin over hero image
issues: Header text (Dashboard/Log out/My Bookings) uses color #2C3531 on transparent header sitting over a dark hero image — readability is borderline at the top of the page before scroll causes the header to gain a background. Consider adding text shadow or a subtle scrim above the header when not scrolled.

critical_code_review_comments: MyBookings.js redirects any non-'user' role to /login (line 66), so an admin visiting /my-bookings is bounced. Review request said the admin header should be visible on /my-bookings too; today it only renders on /. Not a blocker (admins have no personal bookings), but consider allowing admin view or documenting the redirect.
server.py has grown to ~856 lines. Splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/bookings.py, routers/admin.py, routers/payments.py would improve maintainability (non-urgent).

In server.py `_public_user` returns business_name/phone/etc. defaulting to empty strings which is fine, but users created via admin_register or older users may lack these keys — code correctly uses .get() so no bug, just noting.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new features (password reset, reschedule, admin header controls, vendor profile prefill) are fully working front-to-back. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py extracts reset tokens directly from Mongo (collection password_reset_tokens) since inbox isn't reachable. Run with: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_new_features.py -v -o 'addopts='. Frontend E2E uses testids: forgot-email/forgot-submit/forgot-sent, reset-password/reset-confirm/reset-submit/reset-done, user-forgot/admin-forgot, nav-admin-dashboard/nav-admin-logout, reschedule-<code>/reschedule-modal/reschedule-date/reschedule-start-<hour>/reschedule-submit, fld-business/fld-desc/fld-products.
